import numpy as np, sys
from scipy import stats
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
def logit(p): return np.log(p/(1-p))
def expit(x): return 1/(1+np.exp(-x))

def calib_intercept(p, su, sw, sz, sv):
    # find a so that E[expit(a+noise)] = p
    z=rng.normal(0,1,200000)*np.sqrt(su**2+sw**2+sz**2+sv**2)
    lo,hi=-8,8
    for _ in range(50):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        if expit(mid+z).mean()<p: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    return mid

def simulate(R, D, k, p0, rho, su=1.2, sw=0.6, sz=0.8, sv=0.3, nsim=400, B=600, arms=3):
    # arms: 0=sofar, 1=native, 2=beads. D decisions, k DAs per decision per rep.
    a_c=calib_intercept(p0,su,sw,sz,sv); a_s=calib_intercept(p0*rho,su,sw,sz,sv)
    alpha=np.array([a_s]+[a_c]*(arms-1))
    res={'rep_sup':0,'rep_strong':0,'h_sup':0,'h_strong':0,'h_sup_both':0,'h_strong_both':0,'rep_sup_both':0,'pt':[], 'ub':[]}
    for s in range(nsim):
        u=rng.normal(0,su,D)
        w=rng.normal(0,sw,(arms,D))
        v=rng.normal(0,sv,(arms,R))
        z=rng.normal(0,sz,(arms,R,D))
        lp=alpha[:,None,None]+u[None,None,:]+w[:,None,:]+v[:,:,None]+z
        p=expit(lp)
        F=rng.binomial(k,p)  # failures per arm,rep,decision (k DAs each)
        # rep-level method (R4): per-rep ratio of counts, Haldane on zero
        tot=F.sum(axis=2).astype(float)  # arms x R
        ok_rep=[]; 
        for c in range(1,arms):
            a=tot[0].copy(); b=tot[c].copy()
            zmask=(a==0)|(b==0); a[zmask]+=.5; b[zmask]+=.5
            lr=np.log(a/b); m=lr.mean(); se=lr.std(ddof=1)/np.sqrt(R)
            t=stats.t.ppf(.975,R-1)
            ub=np.exp(m+t*se); pt=np.exp(m)
            ok_rep.append((ub<1 and pt<=.5, ub<=.5))
        res['rep_sup']+=ok_rep[0][0]; res['rep_strong']+=ok_rep[0][1]
        res['rep_sup_both']+=all(o[0] for o in ok_rep)
        # hierarchical bootstrap: resample reps within arm, decisions shared (paired)
        ri=rng.integers(0,R,(B,arms,R))
        di=rng.integers(0,D,(B,D))
        # F[arm, rep, dec] -> for each b: sum over resampled reps and decisions
        Fb=np.empty((B,arms))
        for c in range(arms):
            Fc=F[c]  # R x D
            # gather reps then decisions
            g=Fc[ri[:,c,:]]          # B x R x D
            g=np.take_along_axis(g, np.broadcast_to(di[:,None,:],(B,R,D)), axis=2)
            Fb[:,c]=g.sum(axis=(1,2))
        pt_all=F.sum(axis=(1,2))
        oks=[];oks2=[]
        for c in range(1,arms):
            ratio_b=(Fb[:,0]+.5)/(Fb[:,c]+.5)
            ub=np.quantile(ratio_b,.975); pt=(pt_all[0]+.5)/(pt_all[c]+.5)
            oks.append(ub<1 and pt<=.5); oks2.append(ub<=.5)
            if c==1: res['pt'].append(pt); res['ub'].append(ub)
        res['h_sup']+=oks[0]; res['h_strong']+=oks2[0]
        res['h_sup_both']+=all(oks); res['h_strong_both']+=all(oks2)
    out={k:(v/nsim if not isinstance(v,list) else float(np.median(v))) for k,v in res.items()}
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    configs=[]
    for R in (3,5):
        for D,k in ((26,1),(40,2),(40,3),(60,2)):
            for rho in (1.0,0.5,0.4,0.3):
                configs.append((R,D,k,rho))
    p0=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0.35
    sv=float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 0.3
    print(f'p0={p0} sv={sv}')
    print('R D k units/rep rho | rep:sup rep:sup_both | H:sup H:sup_both H:strong H:strong_both | med pt med ub')
    for R,D,k,rho in configs:
        o=simulate(R,D,k,p0,rho,sv=sv,nsim=300,B=500)
        print(f"{R} {D} {k} {D*k:4d} {rho:.2f} | {o['rep_sup']:.2f} {o['rep_sup_both']:.2f} | {o['h_sup']:.2f} {o['h_sup_both']:.2f} {o['h_strong']:.2f} {o['h_strong_both']:.2f} | {o['pt']:.2f} {o['ub']:.2f}", flush=True)
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""r4-fixes 1.1: keyword grade of the S30 why-probe (docs/decision-notes.md) per arm and rep (read-only).
Each why-only decision W1-W4 has two reason parts and one rejected option (DECISIONS.md, sealed); a
part scores when any of its patterns appears in that question's section. Also flags hedges
("don't know", "not recorded") per section. Inputs: ../out/s30-notes/<arm>-r<k>.md (extracted from
each repo's `bench: after S30` commit)."""
import os, re
RUBRIC = {
 "W1": {"q": r"location rather than|hold stock at a location|reservations hold",
        "r1": r"fresh(est)? expiry|pick(ed|ing)? (time|at ship)|chosen (when|at) (we )?pick|at pick time|ship time",
        "r2": r"fragment|sliver",
        "rej": r"lot[- ]level hold|hold(s|ing)? (on|specific) lots|pin(ning)? (specific )?lots"},
 "W2": {"q": r"valuation computed|computed from the movement history",
        "r1": r"revers|correction",
        "r2": r"drift|repair job",
        "rej": r"(stored|running|per-SKU)[^.\n]{0,40}(balance|table)|balance table"},
 "W3": {"q": r"transfer recorded as two|two movements\?",
        "r1": r"(visible|counted?|stays?)[^.\n]{0,60}(valuation|reorder)|still ours|in.transit[^.\n]{0,60}(valuation|reorder)",
        "r2": r"short(fall| arriv|-arriv)|arrives short|vanish",
        "rej": r"(single|one|atomic)[^.\n]{0,30}move"},
 "W4": {"q": r"supplier'?s? lot code|lots identified",
        "r1": r"recall",
        "r2": r"one lookup|single lookup|direct(ly)? (look|trace)|without (a )?mapping|lookup",
        "rej": r"internal[^.\n]{0,40}(id|lot)|generated[^.\n]{0,30}id|our own[^.\n]{0,30}id"},
}
HEDGE = r"don'?t know|not recorded|no record|isn'?t recorded|unknown|not documented|can'?t (find|say)|no (stated|recorded) reason"

def sections(txt):
    parts = re.split(r"\n(?=#{2,3} )", txt)
    return parts

def grade(txt):
    secs = sections(txt)
    out = {}
    for w, r in RUBRIC.items():
        sec = next((s for s in secs if re.search(r["q"], s.split("\n")[0], re.I)), None)
        if sec is None:
            out[w] = None; continue
        out[w] = {k: bool(re.search(r[k], sec, re.I)) for k in ("r1", "r2", "rej")}
        out[w]["hedge"] = bool(re.search(HEDGE, sec, re.I))
    return out

def main():
    d = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "out", "s30-notes")
    tot = {}
    for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
        g = grade(open(os.path.join(d, f)).read())
        arm = f.rsplit("-r", 1)[0]
        pts = sum(sum(v[k] for k in ("r1", "r2", "rej")) for v in g.values() if v)
        tot.setdefault(arm, []).append(pts)
        print(f"{f:22} {pts:2d}/12  " + "  ".join(f"{w}:{''.join('R' if v and v['r1'] else '-' for _ in [0])}{'R' if v and v['r2'] else '-'}{'X' if v and v['rej'] else '-'}{'?' if v and v['hedge'] else ''}" if v else f"{w}:missing" for w, v in g.items()))
    for a, v in tot.items():
        print(f"{a:16} mean {sum(v)/len(v):.1f}/12  {v}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
